sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Snack Rush is a match-three puzzle game, where players must match snack items in a grid-based layout to clear them from the board. The game's grid layout is divided into rows and columns, with each snack item having its own unique properties and points value. Players must swap adjacent snack items to create sets of three or more in a row, either horizontally or vertically. The game's grid layout is designed to be intuitive and easy to use, making it simple for players to navigate and make swaps.

The game's snack items come in a variety of shapes, sizes, and colors, each with its own unique point value. Some snack items may have special properties, such as being worth double points or having a special ability that can be triggered when matched. Players must use their wits and strategic thinking to clear as many snacks as possible within the allotted time.

One of the things that makes Snack Rush so challenging is the game's timed gameplay. Players must clear as many snacks as possible within a set time limit, making it a true test of speed and strategy. As players progress through the game, the time limit decreases, making it even more challenging to clear as many snacks as possible. The game's timed gameplay adds an extra layer of excitement and challenge, making it a truly engaging and addictive experience.

Overall, Snack Rush's core gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging, making it a game that is fun and engaging for players of all ages and skill levels.
